title: Assigning coordinates in a Boolean vector
statement: Let $s,x\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and let $i_1,\ldots,i_k$ be a list of coordinates. Starting from $s$, successively replace each listed coordinate $i_j$ by its value in $x$, in list order, and leave all other coordinates unchanged. The resulting vector is the assigned vector.
hypotheses_covered: A list of coordinates from the $n$ coordinates
